about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the rich, cinematic soundscape of Wildkeepers Rising, where every note carries the weight of an untold legend. Composed by Daniel Keating, this orchestral soundtrack captures the thrill of adventure, the call to heroism, and the echoes of a forgotten bond that once shaped the world. Featuring 13 original tracks spanning over 30 minutes, this early-release soundtrack brings together a vast palette of instruments—both familiar and not—to reflect the diverse and untamed regions of Wildkeepers Rising.

This is just the beginning—additional tracks will be added in a free update as development continues.

Technical Details:
🎵 13 tracks of fully orchestrated original music spanning over 30 minutes
🎵 Available in 48kHz 24-bit WAV & 320kbps MP3 formats
🎵 More music to come in future updates at no extra cost

Let the adventure begin!
